title: Honey bee
brief_description: A study of the domestic bee, including the function in the hive of the workers, the drones, and the queen; the egg, larvae, and cocoon stages of the workers; the metamorphosis of the queen; the swarming of the hive; building a new cone; and honey-making are all dealt with in detail.
